SW.Item.Artifact.TotemOfRegeneration.description: This wooden figurine radiates a warmth like that of a crackling campfire and heals all friends who gather around it.

SW.Item.Artifact.PicnicBlanket.name: PicnicBlanket

SW.Item.Artifact.SoulHarvester.description: Charge it up with the souls you have collected before releasing them into a cluster hex of power.

SW.Item.Artifact.CorruptedBeacon.name: CorruptedBeacon
SW.Item.Artifact.CorruptedBeacon.description: Turns souls into raw power as you fire it in short bursts or in one long, soul-draining blast of ultimate power.

SW.Item.Artifact.TotemOfCasting.name: TotemOfCasting

SW.Item.Artifact.TotemOfShielding.name: TotemOfShielding

SW.Item.Artifact.CorruptedSeeds.description: Instantly sprout into deadly vines, poisoning and binding your enemies while you reap what you’ve sown.

SW.Item.Artifact.DeathcapMushroom.name: DeathcapMushroom

SW.Item.Artifact.SmokeBomb.name: SmokeBomb
SW.Item.Artifact.SmokeBomb.description: The Ender Fog smoke bomb lets you sneak up on enemies, cloaked by shadows.

SW.Item.Artifact.RedstoneMines.name: RedstoneMines
SW.Item.Artifact.RedstoneMines.description: This state-of-the-craft mine launcher will fire a volley of explosive Redstone mines.

SW.Item.Artifact.WitchesBrew.name: WitchesBrew
SW.Item.Artifact.WitchesBrew.description: A witch's secret formula to throw at your enemies and spread a cloud of weakening vapor. What do they put in this stuff?

SW.Item.Artifact.Satchel.Fire.name: FireSatchel
SW.Item.Artifact.Satchel.Fire.description: Throw it on the ground to spread a fierce fire around yourself. You’ll be too hot to handle!

SW.Item.Artifact.Satchel.Freezing.name: FreezingSatchel
SW.Item.Artifact.Satchel.Freezing.description: Throw it on the ground to spread a blistering blizzard around yourself. One of the coolest artifacts there is!

SW.Item.Artifact.Satchel.Poison.name: PoisonSatchel
SW.Item.Artifact.Satchel.Poison.description: Throw it on the ground to spread toxic terror around yourself. Don’t worry, this mob repellent is completely eco-friendly.

SW.Item.Artifact.Satchel.Conductive.name: ConductiveSatchel
SW.Item.Artifact.Satchel.Conductive.description: Throw it on the ground to spread conductive chaos around yourself. It’s a real power trip!

SW.Item.Artifact.CreeperCandle.name: CreeperCandle
SW.Item.Artifact.CreeperCandle.description: Just a completely normal candle, apart from that ominous hss coming from the burning wick... Wait, that’s a fuse!

SW.Item.Artifact.LightningRod.name: LightningRod
SW.Item.Artifact.LightningRod.description: Channels soul-powered lightning, zapping your enemies silly for as long as you hold it.

SW.Item.Artifact.MaimingMushroom.name: MaimingMushroom
SW.Item.Artifact.MaimingMushroom.description: Eaten by daring warriors before battle, unleashing their rage and increasing their attack speed.

SW.Item.Artifact.HasteMushroom.name: HasteMushroom

SW.Item.Artifact.Grindstone.name: Grindstone

SW.Item.Artifact.IronHideLute.name: IronHideLute
SW.Item.Artifact.IronHideLute.description: A beautiful instrument varnished with Potion of the Turtle Master, granting resistance to all friends who catch your groove.

SW.Item.Artifact.WardingChimes.name: WardingChimes
SW.Item.Artifact.WardingChimes.description: Chimes crafted from humbler husk. Their music turns your skin as thick as carapace.

SW.Item.Artifact.WarBanner.name: WarBanner
SW.Item.Artifact.WarBanner.description: Raise the banner of war and grant strength to you and all nearby allies.

SW.Item.Artifact.Honeypot.name: Honeypot
SW.Item.Artifact.Honeypot.description: A sticky treat to trap your enemies as your buzzing friends join the battle! Victory never tasted so sweet.

SW.Item.Artifact.FlameSceptre.name: FlameSceptre

SW.Item.Artifact.BlizzardStaff.name: BlizzardStaff

SW.Item.Artifact.FireBracelet.name: FireBracelet

SW.Item.Artifact.FrostBracelet.name: FrostBracelet

SW.Item.Artifact.PoisonBracelet.name: PoisonBracelet

SW.Item.Artifact.FlameQuiver.name: FlameQuiver
SW.Item.Artifact.FlameQuiver.description: Light your arrows with the flame of your righteous rage.

SW.Item.Artifact.PoisonQuiver.name: PoisonQuiver
SW.Item.Artifact.PoisonQuiver.description: A quiver soaked in venom for that extra sting when your arrows bite.

SW.Item.Artifact.FrostQuiver.name: FrostQuiver
SW.Item.Artifact.FrostQuiver.description: These arrows will have your enemies quivering from both fear and cold.

SW.Item.Artifact.LightningQuiver.name: LightningQuiver
SW.Item.Artifact.LightningQuiver.description: These arrows will strike your enemies like lightning from the skies.
